prompt_text:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated transparent 2.5D fantasy game character action-key pose design candidate, ONE SINGLE character in ONE pose, NOT an animation sheet. The input image is identity reference, not a pose to copy. Re-pose this exact same character into the requested action. Preserve the reference original gold/ivory scales, orange dorsal crest, anatomy, proportions, outfit, ornament patterns and equipment, with crisp painterly illustration finish. Maintain three-quarter facing SCREEN RIGHT, seen from a clearly elevated 45-degree game camera with tops of shoulders visible, warm upper-left lighting. Full silhouette must fit with at least 8% clear transparent margin on all four sides: every weapon/prop tip, clawed toe, crest, banner, tail tip visible and uncropped. Single character on true transparent background. All non-character pixels alpha=0. NO ground, platform, shadow blob, background, checkerboard pixels, text, frame, motion trails, beams, particles, dust, glows, magic glyphs, target indicators or other baked VFX. Equipment is physical solid material. Do not rotate/recolor the idle image: create a genuinely different joint/body pose.
ACTION ID m14/execute: B07-M14 twin-blade guard. Preserve two SHORT crescent copper-gold blades, one in EACH hand, long flexible neck, red-brown light armor and red scarf, long tail. EXECUTE a single anatomical LEFT-hand slash, left arm now forcefully extending diagonally across front toward screen-right, copper blade fully visible. Right-hand sword remains held low backward, not released. Torso twists, forward knee bends in a compact grounded step, rear foot firmly braced, long tail counters to rear. This represents only the first left cut, not the complete two-hit sequence. No slashing trails, no ghosts, no extra blades.
